brief: The canvas displays a grid composed of numerous small squares set against a deep, near-black background infused with a single warm hue. Each square pulses gently and independently, creating a subtle, rhythmic breathing motion across the entire grid. When the viewer clicks anywhere on the canvas, a visible wave radiates outward from the point of impact. As this wave passes over the squares, those affected briefly flash a bright intensity before quickly returning to their natural, steady rhythmic pulse.
